Deck Name : Party Dogs
Author : Norman S. Brown Jr
Description :

gain to pay for the Werewolves comes from Blood Dolls on the little
vampires and Minion Tapping Petaniqua. Blood gain is from Raving the
blood off of the Regenerating Werewolves.

Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
On May 8, 10:06 am, XZealot <xzea...@cox.net> wrote:
> Deck Name : Party Dogs
> Author : Norman S. Brown Jr
> Description :
> A Petaniqua deck where she puts all the Werewolves into play. Pool
> gain to pay for the Werewolves comes from Blood Dolls on the little
> vampires and Minion Tapping Petaniqua. Blood gain is from Raving the
> blood off of the Regenerating Werewolves.

If you Rave a life off a werewolf onto a vampire, I don't believe the
life becomes blood (and therefore it would just drain off.)

And if you want to do that anyway, it seems like you might want to
consider Procurers instead; that task is too lowly for werewolves. :)

Ira

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
ira...@gmail.com wrote:
> If you Rave a life off a werewolf onto a vampire, I don't believe the
> life becomes blood (and therefore it would just drain off.)

It becomes blood. It does not drain off (unless it exceeds capacity).

Messages.Author: ira...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:

OK, thanks for the correction! I guess I should have been able to

their life becomes the vamp's blood. Thanks again!
